source: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)

features.name: Glucose
features.description: Plasma glucose concentration at 2 hours in an oral glucose tolerance test (mg/dL)

features.name: BMI
features.description: Body mass index (weight in kg/(height in m)^2)

features.name: DiabetesPedigreeFunction
features.description: Diabetes pedigree function (genetic score based on family history)

preprocessing_notes: Physiological zero values in Glucose, BloodPressure, SkinThickness, Insulin, and BMI represent missing measurements. In accordance with CO1 & CO2, these zeros are replaced with NaN and imputed using median statistics learned exclusively from training folds to prevent data leakage.
